Bollynights Durham – Diwali Special 🪔 | Kala Chashma 🕶️ 

Durham, get your Kala Chashma ready! 🕶️🔥

Celebrate Diwali with BollyNights at Home & Botanic for a night of Bollywood favourites, Punjabi bangers and Desi dancefloor anthems! Gather your friends, bring the festive energy and get ready to light up the dancefloor. ✨

🎁 FREE Kala Chashma sunglasses for the first 50 customers through the door! Arrive early to claim yours.

▬▬▬ •★• INFO •★• ▬▬▬

📅 Friday 13th November🕚 Start Time: 10pm🕒 End Time: 2am📍 Venue: Home and botanic 🎟️ Online Advanced Tickets starting from £5🚨 PLEASE NOTE: OVER 18s ONLY 🚨⏰ Last Entry: 11.30🎓 STUDENT ONLY👫 Mixed Groups Advised📸 Bring Valid Photo ID: Passport, BRP, or British Driving License & Student ID or proof of being a student (may be required)

▬▬▬ •★• MUSIC •★• ▬▬▬Bollywood | Desi | South Indian 

Expect Dhol drummers, live performances and many more surprises!!

For more info, reservations, birthday bookings or socials private message us directly @bollynights

📸 Please note that any photos or videos taken by our media team may be used for promotional purposes. If you prefer not to be on camera, please avoid our teams during the event or inform them accordingly.
